captions.detailed: This is a 3D model of a desk task lamp featuring a heavy, rounded rectangular base in black. It has a multi-segment adjustable arm constructed of dual parallel metal rods in a matte grey finish, connected by cylindrical hinge joints. The lamp head consists of a dark green conical reflector shade with a small light bulb visible inside, which can tilt relative to the upper arm segment.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an adjustable desk task lamp with a weighted black rectangular base, two hinged grey arm segments, and a tilting dark green conical shade containing a light bulb.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly. It starts by modeling a rectangular base using a box with filleted edges, along with vertical bracket plates. The lower and upper arm segments are built using pairs of cylindrical rods and cross-connecting cylinders representing the hinge axles. The lamp head is constructed by combining a hollow cone (using a loft or boolean subtraction of concentric cones) for the shade, a small sphere representing the bulb, and cylindrical mounting hardware. These components are connected via revolute joints defined at the hinges to enable articulation.
